_note: Facts published AFTER the 30-Sep-2026 as-of date. Not used in the initiation (as-of rule); kept for the first update.

items.fact: Q2FY27 results (Screener, fetched 23-Nov-2026): revenue Rs16,199 cr (+12%), operating profit Rs4,744 cr (29%), other income -Rs752 cr after Rs1,269 cr of exceptional items (pre-tax), net profit Rs1,995 cr (Rs1,989 cr attributable; EPS Rs8.29). Sep-2026 balance sheet: cash Rs20,368 cr, investments Rs16,449 cr, borrowings Rs3,241 cr.
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 52.68% (from 54.48% in Jun-2026), FIIs 14.36%, DIIs 22.27%.

Reuters/The Hindu: CDSCO and the Assam drugs controller ordered Sun to halt manufacture, sale and distribution of ophthalmic products at its Kokrajhar (Assam) plant (show-cause 10-Aug-2026, order 20-Aug-2026) over quality-system failures; eye care ~1% of sales. Sun's clarification to the exchanges on 2-Nov-2026 called it an August-2026 development. Not public by 30-Sep-2026.
